title: Sovereign Mortus (v2 Tight Motivic Lock)
style: Rigamortus style jazz rap, 92 BPM, live acoustic horn section, sharp marching snare drum on beat 2 and 4, punchy kick, walking upright bass, rhythmic vocal stabs, tight breathless delivery locked precisely to the drum groove, Kendrick Lamar style.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Break the grip, rip the script, hit the lock
Pick the lock, redline on the city block
Carve in stone, flesh and bone, take the throne
Bear the weight, hold the crown on my own
Now I decimate the track till they dead and gone
Leave a veteran in shock like a skeleton
Knock 'em off the pedestal, raw like an animal
Cannibal with a flow like a cannonball
